[Context: at the time of disbursement.]
Agriculture accounts for 16% of GDP and some 20% of employment in Macedonia. The sector also plays a central
role in rural areas, where almost half of Macedonia's population lives. The sector performance over the last decade has been
mixed, largely due to weather events. In addition, the sector faces multitude constraints to competitiveness including low
levels of investment in farm technology and supply chains, as well as underdeveloped land and rural credit markets. FYR
Macedonia's status as an EU candidate country imposes additional institutional and regulatory requirements on the sector.
